report_discrepancies.note: Statement of Net Position (p3) prints Restricted for Nutrition Program 150,228, which is the prior-year (2024) ending balance; the fund statement (p6) and School Nutrition Fund schedule (p14) show the 2025 ending balance as 73,734. Unrestricted 5,393,129 is correspondingly 76,494 low; total net position 5,655,922 is unaffected. Recorded as printed.

notes: Modified cash basis school district, fiscal year ended 8/31/2025. Governmental balances come from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (pp4-5): 5,430,210 + 13,974,762 - 13,749,050 = 5,655,922; interfund transfers net to zero in the total column (General -45,000, Other +45,000), so transfers_in/out are null. The statement's General Fund column combines the General, Depreciation and Employee Benefit fund schedules; the General Fund schedule (pp7-11) alone has beginning balance 3,722,972, receipts 12,798,448, disbursements 12,651,974 and ending 3,869,446. Receipts: 'State receipts' split to nameplate capacity tax 5,248 (other taxes) and 6,246,358 intergovernmental using the Statement of Activities p2 line; 'Other receipts' 611,188 split using fund schedules (Activities 515,209, student fees 6,104, fees 6,906, rental 1,200 = charges; local license fees 4,785; donations/grants/capital contributions 55,896; disposal 11,140; other 9,948), all sums tie exactly. Disbursements: 'Student support services' (1,539,717) split by fund column into General 971,356 (support services) and Activities Fund 568,361 (student activities). Hidden transfer: the Depreciation Fund shows 'Transfer from the General Fund' 300,000 (p12) but the General Fund schedule's disbursement lines (including 2600 Operation and maintenance of plant lines totalling 1,371,889) carry no transfer; the statement's O&M of 1,262,006 equals 1,371,889 + Depreciation capital outlay 190,117 - 300,000, so a contra line of -300,000 under the 2600 group plus an other financing line of -300,000 are recorded (review). The General Fund schedule's printed total disbursements 12,651,974 includes the 8000 Transfers 45,000 (recorded as other financing, includes noted in detail_totals). State and federal program lines (3000, 6000) are counted under Instruction (statement Instruction 8,141,938 = General Fund schedule 1000+3000+6000 lines 8,131,888 + Employee Benefit 10,050). General Fund detail has no object breakdown (function codes only), so expenditure detail_category is 'not itemized'; no Exhibit N/O object schedule in the trimmed PDF. Lines with blank 2025 actuals (budget only) are omitted. Statement of Net Position (p3) shows Restricted for Nutrition Program 150,228, which equals the beginning nutrition balance, while the fund statement (p6) restricts 73,734; net position total still ties 5,655,922 (as printed). Component unit Valentine Community Schools Foundation ignored. No business-type funds. Read pages 1-18 of 18
